12.t: Working with data: energy in a food chain
q: How much energy is in the grass?
Calculate the percentage passed from grass to grasshoppers.
Predict the energy reaching the snake and explain.
About 20 kJ: about 10% passes on each time.
Explain where most of the energy goes at each level.
Used for movement, keeping warm, respiration; lost in waste (faeces) and parts not eaten.
